description: This file defines the ProviderStateManager class and ProviderStateException class within the Orleans.Providers namespace. It manages provider states and exceptions related to provider state transitions.

classes.name: ProviderStateManager
classes.description: Manages the state of a provider, allowing presetting and committing state transitions.

classes.name: ProviderStateException
classes.description: Custom exception class for provider state errors, serializable and derived from OrleansException.

methods.name: PresetState
methods.description: Sets a preset state for the provider, with validation based on current state.

methods.name: CommitState
methods.description: Commits the preset state to the current state.
